gripOrHq.title: Startup Immolator
gripOrHq.rulesText: [T]: Pay the rez cost of a piece of ice to trash that piece of ice. Use this ability only if you have just broken all the subroutines of that piece of ice.

gripOrHq.title: Security Code WORM Chip
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Trash a piece of unrezzed ice.

heapOrArchives.title: Priority Wreck
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, pay any number of bits to force the Corp to lose that many bits.

heapOrArchives.title: Broker
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

heapOrArchives.title: Edited Shipping Manifests
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, and the Corp has any credits when you would access HQ, do not access cards from HQ; instead, the Corp loses [1] and gives you a tag, and you gain [10].

heapOrArchives.title: Weather-to-Finance Pipe
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, the Corp loses [4].

rig.title: Junkyard BBS
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

root.title: Olivia Salazar
root.rulesText: For half cost, rounded down, rez a piece of ice installed on this fort. Derez that ice at the end of the run. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

root.title: Roving Submarine
root.rulesText:
Install only inside a subsidiary data fort. This fort may be run only if you installed or advanced a card inside or on this fort during your last turn.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

root.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

root.title: Roving Submarine
root.rulesText:
Install only inside a subsidiary data fort. This fort may be run only if you installed or advanced a card inside or on this fort during your last turn.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

root.title: Chester Mix
root.rulesText: The cost to install ice on this fort is reduced by [2].

ice.title: Neural Blade
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
[Subroutine] The Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during this run.
